output.reason: The collective labour agreement sets PT Centex payroll components that feed into PPh 21 for permanent employees. Gross income includes basic wage, allowances, THR of 120% of monthly wage and an annual bonus. It also includes employer-paid JKK 0.89%, JKM 0.30% and BPJS Kesehatan 4% premiums. The employee-paid JHT 2% and JP 1% contributions are deductible.
